schema: CREATE TABLE "Logins" ("user_id" INTEGER, "login_date" DATE, PRIMARY KEY ("user_id", "login_date"));
correct_query: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN (first_log.min_date + 1) = l.login_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT first_log.user_id) AS consecutive_ratio FROM (SELECT user_id, MIN(login_date) AS min_date FROM Logins GROUP BY user_id) AS first_log JOIN Logins AS l ON first_log.user_id = l.user_id

expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.description: Mutant wraps the numeric offset expression (MIN(login_date) + 1) in SQLite's DATE() function inside a tuple-IN subquery, which interprets the numeric sum as a Julian day number and returns NULL or an ISO date string instead of matching consecutive numeric values.
expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.query: SELECT CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT user_id, MIN(login_date) AS min_date FROM Logins WHERE (user_id, login_date) IN (SELECT user_id, DATE(MIN(login_date) + 1) FROM Logins GROUP BY user_id) GROUP BY user_id) AS g) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM Logins) AS consecutive_ratio
